port.description: TCP port for incoming BitTorrent peer connections. Common range: 6881–6889.

bind_address.description: IP address or interface name to bind to (e.g., 'eth0' or '192.168.1.10'). Leave blank for all interfaces.

max_peers.description: Maximum total number of peer connections across all torrents.

max_uploads.description: Maximum number of simultaneous upload (seeding) slots. Set to 0 for unlimited.

enable_dht.description: Enable DHT (Distributed Hash Table) to discover peers without trackers.

enable_upnp.description: Enable automatic port forwarding via UPnP or NAT-PMP on compatible routers.

max_memory.description: Maximum memory (MiB) to allocate for piece buffers and metadata. Adjust based on system RAM.

download_dir.description: Directory where completed torrents are stored.

incomplete_dir.description: Directory where partial (incomplete) downloads reside until completed.

fast_resume.description: Resume downloads quickly by using stored resume data instead of rechecking all pieces.

log_file.description: Path to log file. Leave empty to log to stderr/stdout.

enable_ssl.description: Encrypt peer connections using TLS (requires peer support).

preallocate.description: Preallocate full disk space for torrent files to avoid fragmentation and I/O delays.

endgame_mode.description: Enable endgame mode: download rare remaining pieces from all connected peers.

min_peers_seed.description: Minimum peers to maintain in seeding mode before pausing new connections.

max_peers_torrent.description: Max peers per torrent (0 = use global max_peers).

items.description: Additional TCP port numbers for IPv4/IPv6 compatibility or multiple interfaces.

extra_ports.description: List of extra ports to listen on (e.g., [6882, 6883] for IPv4+IPv6 or load balancing).

download_rate_limit.description: Maximum download rate (KiB/s). Set to 0 for unlimited.

upload_rate_limit.description: Maximum upload rate (KiB/s). Set to 0 for unlimited.

min_announce_interval.description: Minimum time (seconds) between tracker announces. Reduces tracker load.

max_announce_interval.description: Maximum time (seconds) between tracker announces (fallback interval).

tracker_timeout.description: Timeout (seconds) before retrying a failed tracker.

enabled.description: Whether to use this tracker by default.

global_trackers.description: List of global trackers to append to every new torrent. Avoid adding private trackers.

user_agent.description: Custom user-agent string for tracker identification. Leave empty for default.

fast_open.description: Enable TCP Fast Open (Linux kernel ≥3.7). Reduces handshake latency.

enable_pex.description: Enable Peer Exchange (PEX) to share peer lists with connected peers.

enable_lsd.description: Enable Local Service Discovery (LSD) to find local peers.

share_ratio_limit.description: Upload/download ratio target before auto-stopping seeding. 1.0 = 100%.

seed_time_limit.description: Maximum seeding time (seconds) per torrent before auto-removing. 0 = unlimited.

auto_remove_delay.description: Hours to wait after torrent completion before auto-removing. 0 = disabled.

min_seed_ratio.description: Minimum share ratio required before seeding stops.

min_seed_time.description: Minimum seeding time (seconds) required before seeding stops (even if ratio met).
